about: Hand-written short names. titles: full catalog class title -> short name for the flowchart boxes. labels: a requirement row's catalog wording -> short label for its box and plan row ("" = show the requirement group's name). names: a requirement group's name -> the short one such a row shows. scripts/build-short-titles.mjs keeps these over the rule-based ones (scripts/lib/short-titles.mjs). Every short name must fit (tests/short-titles.test.mjs).
